title: Genie Agents enhancements
body:
* **Increased data source limit**: Each Genie Agent supports up to 50 tables, views, or metric views as data sources, up from 30. See [Technical requirements and limits](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up#tech-requirements).
* **Increased conversation limit**: Each Genie Agent can store up to 200,000 conversations, up from 10,000. See [Technical requirements and limits](/aws/en/genie-agents/set-up#tech-requirements).
